caption: The video captures a small bonfire burning on a sandy beach beneath a sunset sky. Two dark logs form a V at the fire, one angled up-left and one lying to the right, while a calm sea and flat horizon stretch behind them. The sky grades from teal-blue upper left to orange-red along the horizon, and the firelight casts a persistent red glow on the foreground sand. The flame continuously flickers and deforms, its height, brightness and outline shifting frame by frame while its base stays fixed on the logs. Near the middle, the upper flame forms a distinct pale curling loop above the brighter orange base, which then shifts and thins. The red illumination on the sand remains largely steady while the flame's brightness varies with the flickering. In the later portion the flame grows taller and thinner. Small bright particles then appear above it and drift upward. The logs, horizon and cloud shapes remain fixed.
